import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    base = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))

    win_30 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    win_90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    win_180 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)

    items = db["order_items"]
    hist_items = items[items["ts"] < seed_time].copy()
    if not hist_items.empty:
        hist_items["in_30d"] = (hist_items["ts"] >= win_30).astype(int)
        hist_items["in_90d"] = (hist_items["ts"] >= win_90).astype(int)
        hist_items["in_180d"] = (hist_items["ts"] >= win_180).astype(int)

    # --------------------------
    # 1. Order Items Aggregations
    # --------------------------
    order_agg = pd.DataFrame()
    if not hist_items.empty:
        g = hist_items.groupby("product_id")
        order_agg = pd.DataFrame({
            "total_units_alltime": g.size(),
            "total_units_180d": g["in_180d"].sum(),
            "total_units_90d": g["in_90d"].sum(),
            "total_units_30d": g["in_30d"].sum(),
            "total_revenue_alltime": g["price"].sum(),
            "total_revenue_90d": g.apply(
                lambda d: d.loc[d["in_90d"] == 1, "price"].sum()),
            "avg_price_alltime": g["price"].mean(),
            "avg_freight_90d": g.apply(
                lambda d: d.loc[d["in_90d"] == 1, "freight_value"].mean()
                if (d["in_90d"] == 1).any() else 0.0),
            "unique_sellers_alltime": g["seller_id"].nunique(),
            "last_sale_ts": g["ts"].max(),
        })
        order_agg["days_since_last_sale"] = (
            seed_time - order_agg["last_sale_ts"]).dt.days
        order_agg = order_agg.drop(columns=["last_sale_ts"])

    # --------------------------
    # 2. Product-Order Links
    # --------------------------
    product_order_links = pd.DataFrame()
    if not hist_items.empty:
        product_order_links = hist_items[["product_id", "order_id"]].drop_duplicates()

    # --------------------------
    # 3. Review Aggregations (review known only if review_creation_date < seed_time)
    # --------------------------
    review_agg = pd.DataFrame()
    if not product_order_links.empty:
        reviews = db["reviews"]
        hist_reviews = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time]
        if not hist_reviews.empty:
            review_product = hist_reviews.merge(product_order_links, on="order_id", how="inner")
            if not review_product.empty:
                g = review_product.groupby("product_id")
                review_agg = pd.DataFrame({
                    "avg_review_score": g["review_score"].mean(),
                    "total_reviews": g.size(),
                    "last_review_ts": g["review_creation_date"].max(),
                })
                review_agg["days_since_last_review"] = (
                    seed_time - review_agg["last_review_ts"]).dt.days
                review_agg = review_agg.drop(columns=["last_review_ts"])

    # --------------------------
    # 4. Order Status (only orders purchased before seed_time; canceled status
    #    counted only for orders old enough that the status was already set)
    # --------------------------
    order_status_agg = pd.DataFrame()
    if not product_order_links.empty:
        orders = db["orders"]
        known_orders = orders[orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time][
            ["order_id", "order_status", "order_purchase_timestamp"]].copy()
        pos = product_order_links.merge(known_orders, on="order_id", how="inner")
        if not pos.empty:
            # статус мог быть проставлен позже покупки: считаем отмену известной
            # только если с момента покупки прошло >= 14 дней
            pos["is_canceled_known"] = (
                (pos["order_status"] == "canceled") &
                (pos["order_purchase_timestamp"] <= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=14))
            ).astype(int)
            g = pos.groupby("product_id")
            order_status_agg = pd.DataFrame({
                "total_orders_alltime": g["order_id"].nunique(),
                "canceled_orders": g["is_canceled_known"].sum(),
            })
            order_status_agg["canceled_rate"] = (
                order_status_agg["canceled_orders"] /
                order_status_agg["total_orders_alltime"].replace(0, np.nan))
            order_status_agg = order_status_agg.drop(columns=["canceled_orders"])

    # --------------------------
    # 5. Delivery Performance (только доставленные ДО seed_time)
    # --------------------------
    delivery_agg = pd.DataFrame()
    if not product_order_links.empty:
        orders = db["orders"]
        delivered = orders[
            (orders["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna()) &
            (orders["order_delivered_customer_date"] < seed_time)
        ][["order_id", "order_delivered_customer_date", "order_estimated_delivery_date"]].copy()
        if not delivered.empty:
            delivered["delivery_delay_days"] = (
                delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"] -
                delivered["order_estimated_delivery_date"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
            prod_del = product_order_links.merge(
                delivered[["order_id", "delivery_delay_days"]], on="order_id", how="inner")
            if not prod_del.empty:
                g = prod_del.groupby("product_id")
                delivery_agg = pd.DataFrame({
                    "avg_delivery_delay": g["delivery_delay_days"].mean(),
                    "total_delivered_orders": g.size(),
                })

    # --------------------------
    # 6. Payment Aggregations (только платежи, известные до seed_time)
    # --------------------------
    pay_agg = pd.DataFrame()
    if not product_order_links.empty:
        payments = db["payments"]
        hist_payments = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time]
        if not hist_payments.empty:
            order_pay_agg = hist_payments.groupby("order_id").agg(
                total_order_payment=("payment_value", "sum"),
                avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
            ).reset_index()
            product_pay = product_order_links.merge(order_pay_agg, on="order_id", how="inner")
            if not product_pay.empty:
                g = product_pay.groupby("product_id")
                pay_agg = pd.DataFrame({
                    "avg_total_order_payment": g["total_order_payment"].mean(),
                    "avg_payment_installments": g["avg_installments"].mean(),
                    "total_orders_with_payment": g.size(),
                })

    # --------------------------
    # 7. Sales Activity
    # --------------------------
    activity_agg = pd.DataFrame()
    if not hist_items.empty:
        sale_dates = hist_items.groupby("product_id")["ts"].agg(["min", "max"])
        sale_dates.columns = ["first_sale_ts", "last_sale_ts"]
        sale_dates["days_active"] = (
            sale_dates["last_sale_ts"] - sale_dates["first_sale_ts"]).dt.days
        total_units = hist_items.groupby("product_id").size().rename("total_units")
        activity_agg = sale_dates.join(total_units)
        activity_agg["sales_per_week"] = np.where(
            activity_agg["days_active"] > 0,
            activity_agg["total_units"] / (activity_agg["days_active"] / 7.0),
            activity_agg["total_units"])
        activity_agg = activity_agg.drop(columns=["first_sale_ts", "last_sale_ts", "total_units"])

    # --------------------------
    # Merge
    # --------------------------
    result = base.copy()
    for agg_df in [order_agg, review_agg, order_status_agg, delivery_agg, pay_agg, activity_agg]:
        if agg_df is not None and not agg_df.empty:
            result = result.join(agg_df, how="left")

    fill_values = {
        "total_units_alltime": 0,
        "total_units_180d": 0,
        "total_units_90d": 0,
        "total_units_30d": 0,
        "total_revenue_alltime": 0.0,
        "total_revenue_90d": 0.0,
        "unique_sellers_alltime": 0,
        "total_reviews": 0,
        "total_orders_alltime": 0,
        "total_delivered_orders": 0,
        "total_orders_with_payment": 0,
        "days_active": 0,
        "avg_price_alltime": 0.0,
        "avg_freight_90d": 0.0,
        "canceled_rate": 0.0,
        "avg_delivery_delay": 0.0,
        "avg_total_order_payment": 0.0,
        "avg_payment_installments": 0.0,
        "sales_per_week": 0.0,
        "avg_review_score": 0.0,
        "days_since_last_sale": 1000,
        "days_since_last_review": 1000,
    }
    result = result.fillna(value=fill_values)
    result = result.fillna(0)

    int_cols = [
        "total_units_alltime", "total_units_180d", "total_units_90d",
        "total_units_30d", "unique_sellers_alltime", "total_reviews",
        "total_orders_alltime", "total_delivered_orders", "total_orders_with_payment",
        "days_active", "days_since_last_sale", "days_since_last_review",
    ]
    for col in int_cols:
        if col in result.columns:
            result[col] = result[col].astype(np.int64)
    for col in result.columns:
        if col not in int_cols:
            result[col] = result[col].astype(np.float64)

    result = result.reindex(entity_ids)
    return result
